Selector identities and historical reference lists stay fixed; label-cohort weighting only.
Original 8-target and exact three-/one-task observed cohorts retained; unavailable raw data never becomes a new verdict.
Recorded final V2/SCG outcomes, including no-verdict states, preserved. Label-free runtime/selection comparisons unchanged.
This joined CSV labels and frozen export hashes without checking the archived applied-patch hash; original sidecar remains untouched.
Five superseded-assertion class labels are independent labels, not patch-correctness labels. Their class agreement is unchanged; global wrong-patch denominator propagates.
Exactly the frozen 13-task cohort; no selection or skip policy changes.
Historical nominal ceiling is qualified by skips and mismatched patch binding; root cause does not edit old test outcomes.
All four policies and registered secondary REGRESSION_ERROR counting; pre-registered H1/H1b/H2/H3 label-free and unchanged.
Only a new integrity slide note is added. Older reports remain historical originals; this report supplies the corrections.

root_cause.explanation: Run directories were archived and fresh agents reused the same experiment/task identifiers. Harness reports under logs/run_evaluation retained the same run_id/model/task key. Cache reuse checks report existence, not prediction hash. The oracle stamped the current repair hash onto the cached report; the sidecar joined the CSV oracle status to a separately verified frozen hash.
